items.problem: The prescribed build command did not exist and did not produce the host-architecture layout required by the launch helper.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 4039-4044: winapp build exited 1; lines 4164-4166: launch helper found no bin/x64/Debug output.
items.skill_search: SKILL.md Step 3 contained 'winapp build' and repeated it as the preferred/final command.
items.root_cause: The prose assigned compilation to the winapp CLI even though the installed CLI has no build command, and omitted the helper's host-architecture layout precondition.
items.proposed_fix: Replace the command with native dotnet build -p:Platform=<host-arch> and state that launch must run only after build completion.
items.generalizes: Every migrated project uses the same compile-to-packaged-layout handoff before runtime validation.

items.problem: Startup diagnostics discarded the managed HRESULT and selected a generic hint from the native .NET wrapper exception code.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 4635-4642 showed code 0xe0434352 and a generic hint; lines 4921-4933 showed managed HRESULT 0x8001010E and failure inside Application.Start.
items.skill_search: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 parsed the managed type/message but not the '(0x...)' HRESULT in event 1026; hint selection switched only on event 1000 code.
items.root_cause: Managed exceptions are surfaced in event 1000 as wrapper code 0xe0434352, so ignoring event 1026's HRESULT loses the actionable failure class.
items.proposed_fix: Parse and report managedCode, prefer it for hint selection, and surface it through Validate-UwpMigration.ps1.
items.generalizes: Any managed WinUI startup crash can be wrapped by 0xe0434352, including apartment, activation, and interop failures.

items.problem: The common scaffold-to-copied-source namespace mismatch had no documented repair pattern.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 4106-4111: MainWindow could not resolve copied MainPage and copied MainPage could not resolve scaffold App; lines 4135-4138 fixed both with imports.
items.skill_search: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md had namespace rewrites and ambiguous-type guidance but no scaffold root namespace versus retained UWP x:Class namespace pattern.
items.root_cause: The scaffold and copied UWP source legitimately use different root namespaces after bootstrap.
items.proposed_fix: Add a common-build-error section recommending explicit imports/qualification and warning against partial global namespace renames.
items.generalizes: Most migrations combine newly scaffolded App/MainWindow types with copied pages whose XAML and code-behind must retain a consistent original namespace.
